THE PERFECT JARVIS: FAST, CAPABLE, SAFE
1. WHAT YOU FOLLOWED vs 2. WHAT DIVERTED
WHAT YOU HAVE BEEN FOLLOWING (THE CANONICAL PATH)
• PH-00 Governance: Spec rules, $0 budget stack, pre-push guards.
• PH-01 Voice Foundation: Merged via PR #49. < 50ms audio loop,
barge-in, T1 safe local tools, T2 memory fact storage.
• PH-02 Backend Engine: Merged via PR #50. Core job ledger, leases,
DAG execution graph, and Ring-0/1/2 policy broker.
WHAT HAS BEEN DIVERTED (THE JARVIS EXPANSIONS)
• Multi-Bot Architecture (PR #56): Jumped from 1 simple assistant to
Jarvis HQ with 5 local bot workspaces (Scout, Forge, Quill, Atlas, Ops).
• Headless Chrome & Screencasting: Bots automate live web apps and
stream DevTools visual frames directly to the operator screen.
• 3D Armor Visual Showcase: Codex worktree built interactive armor
video and skins (apps/landing) ahead of the core scheduler.
• OpenAI Realtime Cloud Voice: Exception approved in PR #51 to test
speech-to-speech low-latency APIs alongside $0 local models.
• PostgreSQL Seam (PR #55): Evolved SQLite into PostgreSQL with
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to prevent multi-bot concurrency locks.
Verdict: A constructive divergence that makes Jarvis truly powerful.
3. BRANCHES OF THE PATH & 4. CURRENT WORK
• develop (Trunk): Clean baseline with PR #49 (Phase 1) and PR #50 (Ledger).
• PR #55 (Our Active PR): PostgreSQL seam + 5 Hermes worker bot bindings.
• PR #54 (Abhishek): delegate_task conversation wiring + Gemini planner seam.
• PR #56 (Jarvis HQ): Local multi-bot workspace adapted from Bot HQ.
• PR #51: Jarvis delivery scope & OpenAI cloud voice approval record.
• PR #47 / #48: T3 click-to-approve host actions (launching local apps).

• Jarvis HQ: Complete local workspace in apps/hq (PR #56).
• Global scroll-craft skill: Installed across Claude, Gemini, Code, OpenCode.
• Orgo Cloud Computer Cut: Removed proprietary cloud VMs from Bot HQ.
• VNC Relay Cut: Replaced heavy VNC with native Chrome DevTools frames.
